notes.content:
# Session 1 - Smoke over the harbor
- Met Captain Mirel at Blackglass Wharf after the rain quit.
- She says the smugglers use a secret tunnel beneath Old Lantern Square.
- Need to remember: Vargo the debt collector wants his ledger back.
- Party found boot prints that point toward the flooded cistern.

# Session 2 - Abbey bells at dusk
The group reached Saint Branna Abbey before curfew and found Sister Hale hiding the brass key in the reliquary room.
Brother Caldus admitted he heard chanting under the abbey crypt, maybe tied to the moon market.
Mirel promised to trade maps if the party rescues her cousin from Fogmere Crossing.

# Session 3 - Frostward confessions
In Frostward Hollow, Mayor Orsik finally admitted the bridge sabotage.
The party learned the Gray Banner will strike during the revel at Emberkeep Gate.
Blackglass Wharf still feels like the handoff point for every smuggled relic in this mess.
